SORTIE 01 / THE AURELIA BLOCKADE

Operation Sunbreak

The blockade carrier Daybreaker is charging its orbital cannon. Slip through Aurelia’s coast, choose your way up, and take its engines apart. Your squad is coming with you.

01

Break the coast

Clear drone formations. Collect repair rings and weapon cores. Save your wingmates when they call.

02

Pick your line

Fly left for the canyon’s repair rings, or right for the relay’s harder enemies and bigger score.

03

Silence Daybreaker

Climb into orbit. Destroy both engine pods to expose the core. Roll through its fire and finish the job.

Gold rings repair hull. Cyan cores upgrade lasers to level 3. Chained hits build your score multiplier. Roll is safe while the cyan shield is visible, then needs a brief cooldown. Vector energy regenerates when you release boost and brake.

An amber lock becomes ready after a short hold. Keep enemies near the crosshair; a little aim assistance helps your shots connect. Boss engine pods must break before the red central core becomes vulnerable.
